# Sales <> Marketing Sync: 5.1 Sales Enablement Training
Date: 2026-09-16 | Duration: 58m

## Summary
GrowthBook 5.1 focuses on closing the experimentation learning loop through scalable testing, user journeys, funnel analysis, the Learnings module, and AI-powered knowledge sharing. Contextual bandits support rapid optimization for time-sensitive, personalized, and continuously changing scenarios, with examples from Sony, Yasio, and Anthropic. Learnings creates a searchable repository that combines experiment outcomes across tools, preserves institutional knowledge, and distributes insights through Slack and AI agents. Product updates include a 30-user Pro limit, event caps and overage charges for managed warehouses, Enterprise-only event forwarding, composable permissions, holdout APIs, Adobe Experience Platform support, and EU data-residency progress. AI agents can now publish experiments under governance controls, while hosted MCP with OAuth, natural-language dashboards, and expanded AI skills improve self-service. Sales and customer teams requested stronger demos, real data, educational assets, and simpler onboarding. Sources: sections timestamped 02:00–44:35.

## Keywords
Learnings module, Contextual Bandits, Product Analytics, AI agents, Experimentation Culture, Slack Integration

## Action Items

**Elyse Fox**
Distribute updated release slides, future roadmap deck, and recording after the 5.1 release scheduled for next Tuesday (47:50)

**Scott Bailey**
Explore building a demo environment featuring upcoming or beta features to enhance sales enablement and demo capabilities (32:39)

**Unassigned**
Produce recorded office hours videos segmented by feature with engineers presenting, to support sales enablement (24:35)
Explore adding in-platform tooltips, info hotlinks, and demo/documentation links for complex features like Contextual Bandits to improve user discoverability and reduce overwhelm (45:12)
Consider developing specific training sessions focused on 5.1 feature adoption to improve usage and onboarding success for existing customers (43:57)
Develop messaging and sales enablement assets that emphasize experimentation culture transformation and how the new features support it, moving beyond solely feature-focused outreach (33:10)

**Lyndsie Berens**
Investigate API automation issues consuming Apollo sales credits and ensure credits are preserved for the sales team (47:07)
